questions.stem:
Practice form 3.
A theater sells tickets at $5 each. Which variable definition supports a revenue model?
A) Let t be the number of tickets sold.
B) Let t be the color of the curtain.
C) Let t be the name of the theater.
D) Let t be an unrelated temperature.

options.A: Let t be the number of tickets sold.
options.B: Let t be the color of the curtain.
options.C: Let t be the name of the theater.
options.D: Let t be an unrelated temperature.

questions.explanation: The variable should represent the changing quantity that drives revenue.
